comparison: One fixed pretrained and adapted checkpoint. Fresh independent source-disjoint permutation cohort versus 192 independent unrestricted successor maps with self-loops and many-to-one transitions. Same eight states, random presentation and symbolic prompt. No training or model selection.
metrics: Exact state and full path at each depth, natural stationary versus erroneous stalls, repeated vs novel states, transient and cycle lengths, one-hot independent verifier. Intervals by map within distribution. Stratified frequencies are descriptive; denominators can differ.
gate: Exploratory zero-shot portability requires >=90% correct terminal states and >=85% complete paths at K6 on functional graphs; compare permutation calibration separately.
